rows.heading: Rent
rows.text: Rent of $1,210 is due on November 5, 2026.

rows.heading: Deposit
rows.text: Tenant must pay a security deposit of $800 before move-in.

rows.heading: Notice
rows.text: Tenant must give 30 days written notice to end the lease.

rows.heading: Repairs
rows.text: The landlord is responsible for repairs. Report problems to the office.

rows.heading: Late fee
rows.text: A late fee of $45 applies after the grace period.

rows.heading: Terms
rows.text: Security deposit means money held to cover unpaid rent or damage.

rows.heading: Required records
rows.text: Tenant must provide proof of income by November 2, 2026.

rows.heading: Start
rows.text: Employment begins on November 16, 2026.

rows.heading: Salary
rows.text: The pay rate is $25 per hour.

rows.heading: Acceptance
rows.text: You must sign and return the offer by November 6, 2026.

rows.heading: Benefits
rows.text: You must submit benefits forms by November 20, 2026.

rows.heading: Notice
rows.text: Employees must give two weeks notice before resigning.

rows.heading: Terms
rows.text: Nonexempt means eligible for overtime pay under this offer.

rows.heading: Fee
rows.text: The training fee of $50 is waived and will not be charged.

rows.heading: Deadline
rows.text: You must return the SNAP redetermination form by November 12, 2026.

rows.heading: Documents
rows.text: You must submit proof of income and proof of address.

rows.heading: Method
rows.text: You must upload the documents through the benefits portal.

rows.heading: Consequence
rows.text: Failure to respond will close the benefits case.

rows.heading: Appeal
rows.text: You must request a fair hearing by December 2, 2026.

rows.heading: Terms
rows.text: Redetermination means a review of whether you still qualify.

rows.heading: Contact
rows.text: You must contact your caseworker if you need help.
